title: The backlog tests re-initialise the real repository under a pre-push hook
goal: test_backlog.py's git helpers drop GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE and GIT_INDEX_FILE from their environment (as conftest.git_env does), so tests.py run by a pre-push hook in a worktree never runs git init or commit against the real repository; a planted GIT_DIR in the test environment leaves the real repository's core.bare and history unchanged.
notes: S1: a sprint worker's pre-push hook runs tests.py in a worktree, and a test that inherits GIT_DIR can run git init or commit against the real repository (lost kb content). Land it before any worktree subagent runs. The repro uses git grep so it runs on every OS without a POSIX grep on PATH.
